purpose: Defines which actors execute doc-link processing and their responsibilities, write permissions, script operations, Skill-script connection rules, and the layout of the management state files.
summary: Responsibility table of actors: caller/project AI, Skill, deterministic scripts, information-generation AI, search AI, user, with write permissions and prohibitions
Logical script operations with inputs, success results and side-effect or failure promises
Skill-script connection rules: no self-reported stage success, guarded transitions, hidden internal limit H from the generation AI
Impact notification is enumerated mechanically by scripts; no repair judgment or fix proposal inside doc-link
Re-check after a fix is a new operation; check, search, resolve, build and notify are distinct operations
Handling of partial failure in DLID assignment: written DLIDs are kept, failures are reported per document
All doc-link files stay inside the project; temporary files go under .temp/doc-link/<skill>/
Management state stored as JSON under .doc-link/ and tracked by git, split into per-document info files and per-key ToC files
Deterministic byte-for-byte output so merges converge by rebuilding
tasks: Designing or reviewing doc-link Skills, scripts and custom Agents
Implementing script operations and their guards
Deciding who may write what in doc-link
Designing management state file layout and resolving merge conflicts
title: DES-002 実行主体と処理責務
